figurative_meaning_en: in a derogatory sense - bad company or association with immoral people
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খারাপ দলে মিশে পড়েছে, এখন তার জীবন নষ্ট হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy fell into a bad group and went astray.
He got mixed up with the wrong crowd, and now his life is ruined.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali concerns about peer influence on youth morality.
